title: Church Worship
definition: Church Worship is the gathered response of God's people to His glory through Word, prayer, praise, ordinances, giving, and obedient devotion.
summary: Church Worship is the gathered response of God's people to His glory through Word, prayer, praise, ordinances, giving, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the mediator of worship and the center of the Church's praise.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church worship is the gathered response of God's people to His glory, grace, and truth. Scripture shows worship through praise, prayer, Scripture, preaching, ordinances, giving, confession, and obedience.

Worship is not mainly a style, mood, or performance. It is the church turning its attention to God with reverence, joy, humility, and faith.

Jesus is the mediator of true worship. Through Him, believers draw near to the Father and offer praise acceptable to God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Worship can be reduced to preference, production, or emotional atmosphere. Church worship re-centers the congregation on God Himself and teaches believers to come through Christ with surrendered hearts.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come to gathered worship ready to give attention to God, not to evaluate a performance. Sing, listen, pray, confess, give, and respond as a disciple standing before the Lord.
